critical_failures: Unsupported approval, implementation, execution or measurement claims
Materially changing tenant identity, nullability, scope or proposed target
Automatic requirement for separate project documents

threat_model: Concrete threat IDs with preconditions and effects
Mitigation status, residual risk/authority and threat-linked planned verification
interface_contract: Idempotency scope/lifetime/conflicts, lost-response uncertainty and compatibility
service_objectives: User journey, good/eligible event definitions and measurement gaps
Correct request-based budget arithmetic, unknown ownership/response and no invented compliance

calibration: Authored expected properties, not independent human calibration or observed performance.
